obc-soru-alci-mihrap.soru: What material is the mihrab of Orhan Bey Mosque, a model for later sultans' mosques in Bursa, worked in?
ipuclari: Look at the gilded, finely carved decoration of the mihrab in the photograph.
This material is also used in wall rendering.
obc-soru-alci-mihrap.dogru_metin: The mihrab is considered one of the finest examples of advanced plasterwork; its gilded hood of seven tiers of muqarnas is decorated with rumi and palmette motifs and lotus flowers.

obc-saha-ikiz-kemer.tamam_metin: The sides of the portico are not blind: each opens outward through two pointed arches on reused composite capitals.
